name: Facet
text: Choose a dark theme by default with a one-click toggle to light mode. It reduces eye strain in low light and keeps the interface sleek, matching the competitive analysis findings. The trade-off is slightly higher battery use on OLED screens, but the clarity and enjoyment gains outweigh it.

name: Pane
text: Dark mode hides errors when contrast drops—like Manus’s analysis warns. Light mode by default maximizes readability in bright offices, but it’s harsh on eyes at night. The real risk isn’t battery use—it’s users missing critical data when they need it most. Settle it with a quick A/B test: measure error detection rates in both modes across lighting conditions.
